answer: Paying a waiting period of 7 days that no payment can shorten is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. The river is that the door answers to Firebound throwing master urn warrant alone, and a warrant throwing masters sign after kiln yard trials is the lock it turns. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The vault is on the docket. One wander, one entry.
